writingSkills.name: Letter tracing
writingSkills.description: Goes over letters and pre-writing shapes, starting at the right place.

writingSkills.name: Letter formation
writingSkills.description: Forms letters with the right strokes, in order and direction.

writingSkills.name: Writing capital letters
writingSkills.description: Writes capital letters from a model and from memory.

writingSkills.name: Writing small letters
writingSkills.description: Writes small letters from a model and from memory.

writingSkills.name: Letter to sound
writingSkills.description: Knows the sound a written letter stands for.

writingSkills.name: Sound to letter
writingSkills.description: Hears a sound and writes the letter or letters that spell it.

writingSkills.name: Word copying
writingSkills.description: Copies a word correctly, letter by letter.

writingSkills.name: Word writing
writingSkills.description: Writes a word from a picture or from memory.

writingSkills.name: Spelling in writing
writingSkills.description: Uses known spellings when writing words and sentences.

writingSkills.name: Word building
writingSkills.description: Builds words from letters and sounds.

writingSkills.name: Sentence building
writingSkills.description: Puts words in order to make a sentence.

writingSkills.name: Sentence copying
writingSkills.description: Copies a sentence with the right words, spaces and marks.

writingSkills.name: Sentence writing
writingSkills.description: Writes a whole sentence about a picture or an idea.

writingSkills.name: Capital letters
writingSkills.description: Starts sentences, names and I with a capital letter.

writingSkills.name: Spaces between words
writingSkills.description: Leaves a space between words.

writingSkills.name: End marks
writingSkills.description: Ends sentences with a full stop, question mark or exclamation mark.

writingSkills.name: Sentence expansion
writingSkills.description: Adds detail to a sentence: who, where, when, how.

writingSkills.name: Guided writing
writingSkills.description: Writes with sentence starters and a word bank.

writingSkills.name: Story sequence writing
writingSkills.description: Writes what happens first, next and last in a story.

writingSkills.name: Descriptive writing
writingSkills.description: Describes a person, animal, place or thing with describing words.

writingSkills.name: Narrative writing
writingSkills.description: Writes a short story with a beginning, a middle and an end.

writingSkills.name: Informational writing
writingSkills.description: Writes facts about a topic.

writingSkills.name: Paragraph writing
writingSkills.description: Writes a short paragraph: a topic sentence, details and an ending.

writingSkills.name: Editing
writingSkills.description: Finds and fixes capital letters, end marks and spellings.

writingSkills.name: Revising
writingSkills.description: Improves a sentence or short text by adding or changing words.

rubrics.name: KG3 sentence
rubrics.description: One sentence of three or more words about the picture.

criteria.label: Capital letter
criteria.hint: Start each sentence with a capital letter.

criteria.label: Words spelled well
criteria.hint: Check the spelling of words you know.

rubrics.name: Grade 1 sentence
rubrics.description: A whole sentence of four or more words about the picture or idea.

criteria.label: Capital letter
criteria.hint: Start each sentence with a capital letter.

criteria.label: Words spelled well
criteria.hint: Check the spelling of words you know.

rubrics.name: Grade 1 sentence expansion
rubrics.description: Makes a short sentence longer with more detail, keeping its idea.

criteria.label: A longer sentence
criteria.hint: Add words that tell where, when or how.

criteria.label: Capital letter
criteria.hint: Start each sentence with a capital letter.

criteria.label: Words spelled well
criteria.hint: Check the spelling of words you know.

ideas.label: Still about the same thing
ideas.hint: Keep the same idea, and add to it.

ownWords.label: New words added
ownWords.hint: Add your own words to the sentence.

rubrics.name: KG3 sentence frames
rubrics.description: Finishes sentence frames (I see…, I like…) about a topic.

criteria.label: Capital letter
criteria.hint: Start each sentence with a capital letter.

rubrics.name: Grade 1 guided writing
rubrics.description: Three sentences with starters about a topic.

criteria.label: Every sentence written
criteria.hint: Write a sentence in each box.

criteria.label: Enough words
criteria.hint: Write a few words in each sentence.

criteria.label: Capital letter
criteria.hint: Start each sentence with a capital letter.

criteria.label: Words spelled well
criteria.hint: Check the spelling of words you know.

rubrics.name: Grade 1 short paragraph
rubrics.description: A topic sentence, two details and an ending, with help.

criteria.label: Whole sentences
criteria.hint: Each sentence says who and what.

criteria.label: Capital letter
criteria.hint: Start each sentence with a capital letter.

criteria.label: Words spelled well
criteria.hint: Check the spelling of words you know.

topic.label: A topic sentence
topic.hint: Your first sentence tells what it is about.

rubrics.name: Grade 1 story sequence
rubrics.description: A sentence for each picture, in order.

criteria.label: Capital letter

criteria.hint: Check the spelling of words you know.
